note: RISK-ONLY SCOPE. Research materially limited: DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'Connection refused' on all attempts; Google and Bing returned no usable results for quoted queries (Bing served generic 'darling' dictionary/entertainment results, ignoring the quoted company name). OFAC Sanctions List Search (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) was reachable but is an interactive form with no query-string API, so no name lookup could be executed. Therefore sanctions_hit, court_cases, rating, news_risk and rf_supply are all null = NOT VERIFIED, not 'clean'. What was actually read: darlingpumps.in (company site) — describes itself as an Indian submersible pump manufacturer, ISO 9001:2015, founded 1982, with an 'International Distribution' page seeking overseas marketing tie-ups/distributors and an exports@darlingpumps.in contact. That page names NO countries, NO Russian or CIS counterparties, NO shipment records — it is a generic distributor-recruitment page, so it is NOT evidence of supplies to Russia/CIS. Note also that darlingpumps.com resolves to an unrelated Canadian company (Dynapompe, Saint-Laurent QC), so that domain must not be attributed to this supplier. No court, regulator, credit-rating or negative-news source was retrieved for this entity. Per project rules, absence of findings here is not a rejection ground and no adverse inference should be drawn; recommend re-running sanctions (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS Entity List), Indian court (eCourts/NCLT) and rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE) checks when search access is restored. Legal identity, HS codes and shipment volumes deliberately not researched (out of scope).
